summary: Engadget rounds up 30 tech deals from Amazon's October 2023 'Prime Big Deal Days', the second Prime Day-style sale of the year. Deals cover earbuds, smartwatches, tablets, e-readers, smart home gear, TVs, phones and gaming accessories, with Engadget's commentary on why each is worth buying. Some deals require Prime membership, and many match or set all-time lows ahead of Black Friday and Cyber Monday.
one_line: Engadget's roundup of the best tech deals during Amazon's October 2023 Prime Big Deal Days, from AirPods and tablets to TVs and gaming gear.
key_facts: Amazon's second Prime Day-like sale of 2023, called 'Prime Big Deal Days', started in the early hours of October 10, 2023.
The second-generation Apple AirPods Pro dropped to $189 for Prime Day.
The Apple Watch SE is $199, and the Apple 10.2-inch iPad is $249; the iPad scored 86 from Engadget but still has a Lightning port instead of USB-C.
The Samsung Galaxy Watch 6 fell to $270, the lowest price since release, and the Apple iPad mini is $400.
Sony's WF-1000XM5 earbuds are $278, their best price yet, and the Anker Soundcore Space A40 is $54, $25 below its usual price.
The Bose QuietComfort 45 headphones are $230 (about $80 off), and the Bose QuietComfort Earbuds II are $199, a deal for Prime members only.
The Amazon Echo Dot is $23, the Echo Show 5 is $40 (a record low), and the standard Kindle is $75 with 16GB and 300 ppi.
The Kindle Paperwhite 8GB ad-supported model is $95, $45 off MSRP, and removing ads costs $20 more.
The Google Pixel Tablet 128GB is $409 ($90 off, a new low), and the Pixel 7a is a new low of $399.
The Amazon Fire HD 8 is $60 for the 32GB model, and the Fire Max 11 is $150 versus its usual $230.
The LG B2 OLED 55-inch TV is $847, and the Hisense U6K 55- and 65-inch models are $400 and $548.
Buying a $100 PlayStation Store gift card with code PSN100 earns an extra $10 Amazon credit.
The iRobot Roomba 694 is $199, the Razer Basilisk V3 is $44, and the Samsung Pro Plus microSD is $20.
The Backbone One USB-C and Lightning models are $70, $30 off, and the Crucial MX500 internal drive is $46.
